takes.headline: 冷えた夜、熱い二人
takes.take: サンズの3Pは成功率15.6%、ブルックスも0/3と冷え切った夜。ならばと残り23.8秒、デュラントと鼻を突き合わせて2つ目のテクニカル、退場。SNSではオーナーまで巻き込む場外戦つきの因縁である。シュートは入らず、口だけは絶好調。面倒くさくて、最高に熱い。管理人はこの二人が大好きです。
takes.takeEn: Phoenix shot 15.6% from three and Brooks went 0-for-3 on a freezing night — so he closed it his way: nose-to-nose with Durant with 23.8 seconds left, a second technical, and an ejection. The feud even spills onto social media, dragging the Suns' owner into it. Their shots weren't falling, but their mouths were in midseason form. A total headache, red-hot to the end — and the editor loves them both.

takes.headline: KPJ、マジックと契約
takes.headlineEn: Kevin Porter Jr. signs with the Magic
takes.take: 低迷するマジックの救世主となれるのか…というかマジックをレギュラーシーズン2位に予想した管理人を救ってください
takes.takeEn: Can he be the savior of the slumping Magic... actually, please save the editor who picked the Magic to finish second in the regular season.
